verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line on the tools page saying a section 'contains reports, studies, and data on various aspects on USCIS operations,' which suggests published operational data. Nothing shows it is offered as bulk, machine-readable downloads that need no scraping. The Torch APIs are per-case status and FOIA rails, not bulk public-data extracts. Missing for 10: evidence of downloadable dataset files (CSV/XLSX/JSON), case or processing statistics extracts, a data catalog or bulk endpoint, documentation of formats and update cadence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
